newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat despite rate drop.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat despite rate drop.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 476.00/477.00 per dollar in a quiet session that saw only modest Central Bank participation despite a six- percentage point drop in interest rates, traders said.
"The fall in TEM yields didn't spur much foreign exchange action as so little TEM paper was placed," said one broker.

Yields on six-month paper fell to 27.93 percent from last week's 34.12 percent rate at today's 20 billion bolivar ($42 million) auction of Central Bank TEMs. Last week the Bank more typically offered 50 billion bolivars of paper.
However "tomorrow could well see dollar demand picking up steam," said another broker who described the day's session as "well-balanced".
Traders reported constant but only light Central Bank participation thoughout the day, with dollars offered up to an apparent ceiling of 476.30 bolivars per dollar.
